description: List the docket entries in a federal case that have a document available, with the entry number, what the entry says, and a link to the document where the source publishes a free one. Use this when a user asks what documents are on file, whether an order or a motion is available to read, or for a copy of a filing. Availability depends on what the court source publishes; an entry with no free document is reported as such rather than guessed at. Identify the case with case_number (and court, if known), or with matter_id for a case already saved to the account. No account is needed to give a case number. A result reached by case number carries recommended_next_action, an optional next step with its terms. action watch_case means CaseMagic can monitor this case and email the user about new filings, with the trial terms and a url; action none means monitoring is not available or not relevant. Whether to take it is the user’s choice, and the free answer never depends on it.

case_number.description: The case number as the court writes it, for example 1:23-cv-11195 or 2:24-cv-01234-ABC. Judge initials are optional and are ignored when matching.

court.description: The court, as a CourtListener-style code such as cacd, nysd or ilnd. Optional: leave it out when the user does not know which district the case is in.

limit.description: How many documents to return, newest first. Defaults to 20.

matter_id.description: The CaseMagic matter id, as returned by create_case_passport or shown in an earlier result. Omit it when the account follows exactly one case and that is the one meant.

name: get_case_documents

availability_note.description: What is and is not listed.

case.description: The case: court, case number, caption, filing date, status, judges, nature of suit, latest activity and docket size.

case_number.description: Case number as the court writes it.

case_status.description: open, terminated, or null when the source does not say.

court.description: The court, as a code and a name.

docket_entry_count.description: How many entries the court docket has.

filing_date.description: ISO date the case was filed.

id.description: CaseMagic id of the court case.

latest_activity_at.description: ISO timestamp of the latest docket activity.

terminated_date.description: ISO date the case was terminated, or null while it is open.

case_url.description: The case’s public page on CaseMagic, which offers free email alerts and Watch.

connect_token.description: Short-lived token for create_case_passport, present on a lookup by case number.

docket_coverage.description: How much of the court docket CaseMagic holds for this case.

documents.description: Entries with a free document, newest first.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: a code, a message and, where there is one, an action such as a link to give the user.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, for example CASE_NOT_FOUND or MULTIPLE_CASES_FOUND.

message.description: What went wrong, in a sentence.

matter_id.description: The account matter id when the case was read through a saved case; null for a lookup.

recommended_next_action.description: The offer to make after answering, decided by the server: action watch_case when the case is open and can be monitored, none otherwise.

card_required.description: Whether a card is collected for the trial.

plans.description: The three plans with price and how many cases each covers.

price_after_trial.description: Price of the entry plan after the trial.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence the assistant can repeat.

suggested_message.description: One sentence the assistant may say, once.

url.description: Where the user starts watching this case.

source.description: Which court source answered, when it was read and where it can be seen.

url.description: Link to the docket at the source.

what_comes_next.description: One sentence on where to send a user who wants to hear about new filings.
